question: How must this teaching be guarded in the world of mortals among the lowest of men?
premises: The teaching is to be concealed.
Concealment must be done with effort.
The context is the mortal world among the lowest of men.
inference: Therefore this teaching must be carefully kept secret in the mortal world among unworthy people.
plain_english: It must be carefully concealed in the mortal world among the lowest of men.
